answer: The zephyr multiplier is published, charged in terrace, and opal lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 15 for each account already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 3669 identities would post 4851 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
